data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (converter, holidays, mail draft with offset and dates). It gets the recipient wrong as a parameter (the true one is fixed at ops@example.com). It also ties the holiday country to city B, and it ends with "Send or discard" instead of the required Discard. The spec is mostly concrete, but the ambiguous final step (sending is explicitly forbidden), the vague parameter names, and unspecified details like selecting the month and reading the dates would make an automation risky.
